name: LearnFloo → Notion: members database
code:
const DATABASE_ID = 'your-database-id'
const d = msg.data
const u = d.user ?? d.registration?.user ?? {}
const about = d.session?.title ?? d.event?.title ?? 'Member'
out.push({ json: { method: 'POST', url: 'https://api.notion.com/v1/pages', body: { parent: { database_id: DATABASE_ID }, properties: {
  Name: { title: [{ text: { content: u.name || u.email || 'Unknown' } }] },
  Email: { email: u.email ?? null },
  Type: { select: { name: msg.event } },
  About: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: about } }] },
  Date: { date: { start: msg.createdAt } },
} } } })
note:
Credential: Header Auth, name Authorization, value "Bearer <Notion integration secret>". Share the database with the integration.
Database properties: Name (title), Email (email), Type (select), About (text), Date (date). Set DATABASE_ID.
